evidence_tiers.EXTERNAL_CAPTION: third-party transcript time cue, unvalidated words
evidence_tiers.ASR_CANDIDATE: offline ASR hypothesis if installed licensed model is available
evidence_tiers.NATIVE_SPEECH_REVIEWED: human listener checks original speech word phrase and timestamps
evidence_tiers.NATIVE_WORD_ALIGNED: phoneme model/forced aligner with spot-verification and uncertainty

nonpromotion_rules: No local model weights means zero ASR candidates; never call model API
caption proxy may not be relabeled as native speech
acoustic energy does not identify words or pauses when music present
native visual PTS vs caption cue is cue-to-visual, not actual speech-to-visual lag
visual transitions sampled at finite intervals produce bounded change windows, not exact edit cut
V3-55 63.8s video cannot be used for a fair 26m original outcome comparison
all model or learning gain claims forbidden
offline_candidate_due_diligence: openai/whisper MIT both code and released weights, needs checkpoint
SYSTRAN/faster-whisper MIT runtime, needs CTranslate2 and model weights
ggml-org/whisper.cpp MIT implementation, still needs weights
m-bain/whisperX BSD-2-Clause wrapper, forced aligner dependent weight/license review

success_gate.native_audio_phrases: At least 8 of 12 anchors with independently verified uttered words + error bounds; otherwise NO_GO
success_gate.architecture: exact mapping to existing V3 finite compilers, host checks, opt-in contract, no production changes
success_gate.frozen_checks: existing V2/V3/Bench and new offline negatives exact-head
